text: Final verdict on the job watch observation from the shared-expense-tracker pilot: not an engine defect. The execution-runtime contract deliberately keeps the replacement lineage visible: a Job whose replacement Attempt won still reports the earlier failure under latestFailure with the retry decision JOB_RESULT_ALREADY_ACCEPTED (pinned by the test "300 to 600 is one provider Job with replacement Attempt lineage and one accepted winner"). An agent must read runtimeStatus and acceptedAttemptId first; latestFailure is history, not the current state. Close without engine change.
